nodes.intent: the dry race and its three paddle gates
nodes.note: A walled race open to the sky, running north from the sea wall up to the mill yard. A dry walk three wide on the west side, the live channel on the east behind a wall two courses high. Three paddle gates cross the walk, each a board of planks the wheel lifts and drops: the first slowly, the third quickly. A short pound of walk lies between each gate and the next, long enough to stand back and watch the next one.

stations.note: The first paddle gate across the walk, between the tail pound and the first pound.
The second paddle gate, between the first pound and the second.
The third paddle gate, between the second pound and the head pound under the yard.
The middle of the first pound, past the first paddle.
The middle of the second pound, past the second paddle.
The head pound, past the third paddle, at the foot of the way up to the yard.

nodes.intent: the mill yard at the head of the race
nodes.note: A cobbled yard under the mill's wall, open to the sky, where the race comes up out of the ground. The end of the level.
